title: The green cost: Close to 2 lakh trees likely to be felled for Bidadi AI Township
description: Pointing to the data, Nagaraju M.R., a farmer protesting against the project, questioned the government’s claims that farmers in the region are suffering losses from agriculture and that there is no demand for the crops grown there. “Which farmers who are suffering losses continue to grow such a wide variety of crops? The numbers alone suggest how farmers in this region are thriving,” he said
